citations.assessment: The checked Sukkah has Shmuel bar Ḥatai and ends the chain with Rav. It also calls Yitzhak bar Ashyan Rav. Heilprin’s opening spelling and title remain witness-specific.
Gittin preserves the full chain with Rav Hamnuna in the final position and Shmuel bar Aḥitai. Heilprin gives Aḥotai and proposes deletion of the final Hamnuna only.

notes.text: The checked Sukkah has Ḥatai and ends with Rav. The checked Gittin has Aḥitai and ends with Rav Hamnuna. Heilprin gives a different spelling for Gittin and calls its final “Hamnuna” a scribal error.
